question: In the spent FCC catalyst assessment, what shares do thermal power and solar power have in the 2060 electricity mix?
rendered:
<document title="Environmental and Preliminary Economic Assessment of Integrated Resource Recovery from Spent Fluid Catalytic Cracking Catalysts">

The 2060 electricity mix is listed in the document as follows:

- Nuclear power: 10.31%
- Wind power: 36.50%
- Hydro power: 14.43%
- Solar power: 36.69%
- Thermal power: 2.07%

Therefore, the shares of thermal power and solar power in the 2060 electricity mix are 2.07% and 36.69%, respectively.
